metadata.title: Research Findings Brief
metadata.subject: Evidence-first research readout for neutral product discovery
metadata.author: PresentationKit

processFlow.title: How research becomes a decision
processFlow.subtitle: Findings move from question to evidence, synthesis, recommendation, and next step.
processFlow.caption: Research is useful when it changes the next decision.

footprint.title: Evidence coverage
footprint.subtitle: Make sample, sources, confidence, risks, and next learning explicit.
footprint.caption: Coverage keeps findings honest.

architecture.title: Research evidence model
architecture.subtitle: Qualitative and quantitative inputs become findings and decision options.

slides.label: 1 / research context
slides.title: Research findings should answer a decision question
slides.headline: The brief connects evidence to the choice the team needs to make.
slides.supportingLine: Start with the research question, coverage, and path from evidence to recommendation.
slides.speakerNotes: Frame the research around the decision it informs and the limits of the evidence.

slides.label: 2 / research proof
slides.title: Findings are stronger when confidence is visible
slides.headline: Evidence, inference, and uncertainty are shown as separate things.
slides.supportingLine: The readout should make it easy to trace recommendations back to observed evidence.
slides.guardrailLine: Guardrails: state sample limits; separate fact from inference; name uncertainty.
slides.speakerNotes: Show enough traceability that the audience trusts both the findings and the caveats.

slides.label: 3 / research ambition
slides.title: The dream: better decisions from clearer learning
slides.headline: Research creates value when it reduces assumptions and sharpens the next experiment.
slides.closingLine: Let the evidence change the decision, and let the caveats shape the next question.
slides.speakerNotes: Close on decision quality and a practical next learning step.
